name: Igarashi
source:
Igarashi is a classmate of [url=/c82594]Satoru[/url] and [url=/c77624]Ayano[/url]. He is quite close to Satoru and are therefore good friends. They often go out with their friends at the arcade game centre.

Like many, Igarashi thinks that Ayano is an "ojousama" and therefore addresses her with respect.
